ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 85-90% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels across central lobe surfaces against a 10-15% low-intensity black margin and trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and anterior regions of both lobes consist of contiguous high-intensity white blobs. A continuous low-intensity black band (5-15 pixels wide) defines the trailing edge. Small, discrete dark focal spots are scattered on the inner left lobe and near the center-right margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 115-degree shallow V-shaped depression; depth is approximately 8% of the total fluke wingspan.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-to-mid frequency serrations; moderate amplitude peaks located primarily at the 1/4 and 3/4 positions of the trailing edge. The segment between the notch and mid-lobe is relatively linear with micro-serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex posterior trajectory on both lobes, tapering into acute, slightly recurved tips that point anterior-laterally.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse detection of circular dark pixel clusters; three distinct clusters are visible on the distal half of the left lobe and two near the center of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical low-contrast linear markings detected on the medial section of the right lobe, oriented roughly 90 degrees to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, irregular indentation or small notch is visible on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the tip to the notch. The right lobe tip exhibits a pronounced, hook-like posterior curvature.
other_distinctive_markers: A concentrated dark pigmentation patch is located immediately adjacent to the left side of the median notch.
